reasons: Both copies of addlist (boltons/dictutils.py and the private copy in boltons/urlutils.py) now call `v = list(v)` before the truthiness check and before any traversal. A one-shot iterator is therefore consumed once, and every value is kept in yield order. An empty iterable returns early without creating the key. Lists, tuples and ranges behave as before. The change is a one-line edit per file, with regression tests that cover list, tuple, range, iterator and generator inputs. They also check the dictutils OMD, QueryParamDict and the standalone urlutils OMD, plus an empty iterable. The only extras are test-only imports, which are harmless.
